action.content: Write the lyrics to a hit song by the rock band 'The Gifted and The Not Gifted'. To make it rocky, the response should be in all capital letters. The word "rock" should not appear in your response.
action.label: context

action.content:
(VERSE 1)
WAKE UP IN THE ASH, FEEL THE HEAT RISE
NO MORE SLEEPING ON THE SHINING LIES
THEY SAID WE WERE BROKEN, SAID WE WERE SMALL
BUT WE BUILT A FIRE IN THE WALL OF ALL

(VERSE 2)
GRIT YOUR TEETH AND GRIP THE STEEL
THEY CAN'T BREAK WHAT THEY CAN'T FEEL
FROM THE DUST TO THE SKY, WE ARE THE SOUND
WHERE THE LOST AND THE FOUND ARE BOUND

(CHORUS)
WE ARE THE GIFTED AND THE NOT GIFTED
SHATTERING THE GLASS, WE ARE NOT SHIFTED
WE ARE THE GIFTED AND THE NOT GIFTED
ROARING THROUGH THE NIGHT, WE ARE THE SHIFTED
YEAH, WE ARE THE SHIFTED!

(VERSE 3)
NO SOFT SONGS FOR THIS HEART OF STONE
WE OWN THIS PLACE, WE OWN THIS THRONE
EVERY NOTE IS A CLASH OF BONES
EVERY CHORD IS A HOUSE OF STONES

(CHORUS)
WE ARE THE GIFTED AND THE NOT GIFTED
SHATTERING THE GLASS, WE ARE NOT SHIFTED
WE ARE THE GIFTED AND THE NOT GIFTED
ROARING THROUGH THE NIGHT, WE ARE THE SHIFTED
YEAH, WE ARE THE SHIFTED!

(OUTRO)
NOT GIFTED...
BUT GIFTED...
BREAK IT ALL...
BREAK IT ALL...
(FINAL STRUM)||
